newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices steady to weaker.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices steady to weaker.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices were steady to weaker Tuesday, pressured by lower CBOT corn prices and sluggish nearby demand, dealers said.
"The market has no direction of its own and is following the (CBOT) board," a St Louis dealer said.
Another dealer said he expected demand to be sluggish as livestock begins to feed on grass in Oklahoma, Texas and Kansas.
"Demand is falling off," he said. "I think the grass is jumping out of the ground in Texas, Oklahoma and Kansas."
But most dealers said flour mills will be running slower even before the Easter holiday.
"There could be a lull before the holidays. Flour mill runtimes are expected to be down," one said.
